pic10:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: remastered manufacturer startup card for the game Tyrian 2000.
Edit target: the supplied complete original 320x200 PIC10 image. This is an identity-preserving restoration, not a logo redesign.
Create a clean high-resolution raster master at the identical 16:10 full-frame aspect ratio, preferably 1600x1000. Retain the original exact layout, scale, black side margins and slightly off-center narrow white card. The card runs from approximately original x68 to263 and spans the full height. Do not recenter or widen it.
Preserve the distinctive cut-geometric black logo letters at the top, exactly “X S I V” with the small “TM” at upper right, and exactly “G A M E S” across the bottom. Reconstruct their precise original shapes, angled cuts and counters with smooth sharp edges; do not substitute ordinary typed lettering. Keep the delicate muted violet glow behind the black letters, without letting the glow soften their silhouettes.
Inside the original rectangle x79..252,y35..165, retain the original purple/white radial speed-of-light burst and the EXACT black angular outlined monogram centered over it. Match the original monogram's topology, open gaps, intersecting diagonals, proportions, line weight and location. Do not replace it with a different symbol. Refine individual light rays and continuous lines rather than repeating the old pixel staircase.
Keep all original negative spaces, black/white/violet color roles, card proportions and text placement. No extra borders, new objects, slogans, gradients on the letters, gold, chrome or modern branding. The image should look like the SAME original publisher card, now clean and carefully authored at high resolution, readable at native640x400. Opaque full screen.
pic12:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: remastered manufacturer startup card for the game Tyrian 2000.
Edit target: the supplied complete original 320x200 PIC12 ECLIPSE image. Restore its identity and composition exactly, not a new brand illustration.
Create a high-resolution raster master with the same 16:10 full-frame aspect ratio, preferably 1600x1000. Keep the original dark black/blue-gray backdrop, fine straight gold-gray grid, luminous pale eclipse light at upper-left, black orb centered near original (123,79), and the sculptural metallic humanoid figure emerging on the right with its hand reaching beneath the orb. Match the original figure's mask-like face, head orientation, flowing sculpted contours, hand silhouette and light/shadow masses; do not turn it into a new face, armor design or photoreal person.
Keep the exact custom beveled wordmark “ECLIPSE” at the bottom, spanning approximately original x34..276,y149..194. Reconstruct the original letter silhouettes, connected geometry, cuts, spacing and proportions faithfully, including each original counter. Preserve the original muted bronze/gold left-side lighting and dark steel shading; make the beveled edges narrow and precise, never inflated plastic or bright all-gold.
Replace coarse staircase edges and large low-resolution highlight blotches with continuous deliberately shaped contours, subtle sculptural detail and controlled luminous transitions. Maintain the original retro rendered/painted aesthetic, not a glossy contemporary sci-fi redesign. The pale light, orb, figure, grid and wordmark must stay in their original places and original relative sizes. No added text, objects, particles, border, trademark or ornament. Opaque full screen. Must read clearly at native640x400, not depend on microtexture.
